ns2:section.sectionText: Oral and Written Communication II, 3 hours. Continuation of the Oral & Written Communication sequence: continues development of skills in speaking and writing with a special emphasis on argumentative discourse. Completion of both SPCM 111 and 112 satisfies the Composition I requirement and the requirement of a public speaking course for those students whose curricula have such a requirement. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. CREDIT IS NOT GIVEN FOR BOTH SPCM 111 AND 101. CREDIT IS ALSO NOT GIVEN FOR BOTH SPCM 111/112 AND RHET 105/108.
ns2:section.sectionDegreeAttributes: Discovery, and Freshman Composition I course.
